correctness.rationale: The sublevel set is (-delta^(1/m),delta^(1/m)); its delta^epsilon neighbourhood has radius R=delta^(1/m)+delta^epsilon, comparable to delta^min(epsilon,1/m). Exact leftmost Cantor cylinder masses imply mu([0,r]) is comparable to r^(log 2/log 3). These two comparisons prove the two-sided asymptotic. The lower bound proves no larger exponent can hold.
